milestone.name: string
milestone.acceptance: array of strings: gate that must pass before the next milestone starts
milestone.tasks: array of task objects, ordered; position = current_task_index
milestone.acceptance_verified: optional string: set when a human has verified acceptance; suppresses the review issue
milestone.acceptance_commands: commands the acceptance task's gate runs
milestone.automated_acceptance: set by the referee when the acceptance task passed

task.index: integer, 0-based position inside the milestone's tasks array
task.title: string
task.description: string: one isolated, bite-sized unit of work
task.requires_human: optional string: why a person must do or approve this task; autopilot stops here
task.deferred: optional boolean: human task parked for later; the autopilot skips it and it stays open until mark-task-done
task.kind: optional "build" (default) | "acceptance": runs the milestone acceptance suite in the gate
task.depends_on: optional array of task ids that must be done first
task.verification: set by the referee when accepted: level reviewed_and_validated | acceptance_suite | human | validated_only | review_only_pre_repair
